source: Local CCC manual panel and BLS CPI; current dataset vintages.
method: Expanding window with at least 12 training observations. Assume a one-quarter TLF publication delay: target Q trains through Q-2. CPI lags 1-3 only. Re-select lag using training error on identical training rows at each origin. Compare with trend-only and last available actual on identical target quarters.
gaps: Pseudo-out-of-sample, not a real-time vintage backtest. CPI revisions and historical CCC publication dates are unavailable. Quarterly means can have missing months. Lag zero from the original in-sample search is excluded because target-quarter CPI would be unavailable at this forecast origin. Small test sample, overlapping training windows and mixed CCC definitions limit conclusions.
units: percentage points for errors; percent for TLF
